goal: File upload review: type checks, size limits, storage location and execution risk.
use: File upload review: type checks, size limits, storage location and execution risk. Use when code accepts files from users.

steps.note: Check the type. Flag checks based only on the file extension or client header.
Check size. Each upload needs a size limit at the server.
Check storage. Uploads must not be stored in a web-served or executable folder.
Check names. Flag user-supplied file names used as paths.
Report. Each upload path with its gap, file and line, and the fix.
